analysis.narrativeEn:

· Significantly below SMA100/200 ($1.21/$1.35) — Long-term downtrend persists.
· 52-week position (2.8%) + near 52-week low ($1.01).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.2→45.8) — Attempted to exit oversold but is sideways in neutral territory, showing lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0025→-0.0012) — Improving in negative territory, signaling bottoming action.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $1.09) — Sideways near the middle band, searching for direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.06) — Adjacent to 5-day low ($1.05), with potential downside to Pivot S1 ($1.03).
· Swing resistance ($1.13) — Adjacent to SMA20/50 resistance, potential for trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) — Capped by 5-day high ($1.09), supported by 5-day low ($1.05).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.00x) — Lack of significant volume accompanying current moves, moderate confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — Wait-and-see for 5 consecutive sessions, need to confirm breakout above $1.06 support and $1.13 resistance.
